name: Longsword
description: A plain, well-kept longsword with a leather-wrapped grip worn smooth by use.

name: Shortsword
description: A short, quick blade made for close quarters and the gaps between armor plates.

name: Dagger
description: A slim dagger, balanced for the hand rather than for throwing.

name: Quarterstaff
description: An ash-wood staff shod in iron at both ends. Scuffed sigils run along its length.

name: Bell-Bronze Rapier
description: A slender blade forged from a cracked sanctuary bell. A narrow fuller runs down the bronze-alloyed steel so that every parry rings with a clear, steady pitch.

name: Ashen Censer-Mace
description: A heavy iron mace whose hollow head is pierced like a sanctuary censer, forged by the Ashen Order to crack calcified bone.
